title: The reactivity system: ref, reactive, and how it differs from React’s

videos.script:
Something changed. What on the screen has to be drawn again? Every framework answers that question, and the answer shapes everything you write. {{models}} React answers it by running your whole component again and comparing. Vue answers it by remembering what each piece of the page read.

{{sandbox}} Today you make a sandbox beside the planner, a second project for experiments, and watch a component's setup run once while its render runs four times.

{{ref}} Then the two tools. ref, which wraps any value and asks you to write dot value. {{reactive}} And reactive, which wraps an object in a proxy. You will change an object behind the proxy's back and watch the page not notice.

{{lost}} Then three ways to lose reactivity without any error at all. They look different, and they are the same mistake.

{{queue}} Then the queue. Three changes in a row cause one redraw, and the page catches up a moment later.

{{data}} And last, the planner reads its courses from a file, and you meet the error that says a request reached a page instead of data.
